anchor.chooseFailed: Could not set the direction. Try again.
anchor.noCandidatesDesc: Anchoring reads candidate directions out of what this agent has actually been doing. It has not run yet for this expertise, so there is nothing to choose between.
anchor.pending: Waiting for you to pick a direction
anchor.pendingDesc: A domain is a choice, not a discovery — the same agent can be anchored two different ways and both are correct. Pick one before it starts building rules.
create.failed: Could not create it. Try again.
create.filterHelp: One executable test: which conversations count as practice for this expertise, and which do not. This is what keeps it from learning from everything.
create.filterPlaceholder: e.g. the conversation is diagnosing a live incident with observable symptoms. Design discussions and general ops questions do not count.
detail.chart.legendBars: bars = learned that round (blue = you were in the conversation)
detail.chart.noProjection: The fit is not reliable ({{reason}}), so no projection is drawn and no estimated number is shown.
detail.chart.speculative: Treat this projection as a rough estimate: the observation has not yet covered a full learning cycle, so the curve has not turned and the ceiling is inferred rather than measured. Run {{n90}} will move as more practice comes in.
detail.chart.title: Rules learned, as a share of the estimated ceiling
detail.chart.trustworthy: At the current pace, {{remaining}} more practices reach 90% (run {{n90}}), and 95% at run {{n95}}. The observation has covered a full learning cycle, so the projection has evidence behind it.
detail.headline: Practised {{runs}} times, learned {{lessons}} rules.
detail.notPractisedDesc: The direction is set. It starts building rules the next time a conversation matches the filter below — nothing to chart until then.
detail.shapeClause.growing: and the curve is still climbing
detail.shapeClause.noisy: though the curve is too noisy to read
detail.shapeClause.stalled: but the curve never really got going
detail.subheadOk: The estimated ceiling for this domain is {{ceiling}} rules, {{shape}}.
detail.subheadUnusable: The fit is not usable — maturity cannot be computed for this domain.
empty.desc: Rules cannot be written from theory. Let it do real work first and keep the places it got wrong — those are what can be taught.
empty.title: It has not learned anything yet
headline.flat: {{name}} has flattened out — it has learned what can be taught.
headline.none: None of them has flattened yet.
insights.title: What it noticed across all these practices
layers.invented: Layers made up — no canonical model
layers.noteBody: Each expertise gets its layers from its own canon during anchoring — a different domain means a different set. A layer at zero is a gap the canonical model exposed, not a rendering hole.
layers.noteTitle: Layers come from the domain’s own canon, not a global enum
layers.title: Which layers it learns at
layers.unanchored: {{count}} rules are not anchored to any canonical entry.
maturity.reason.low-confidence: too few practices, or the curve is too erratic to fit
maturity.reason.tau-pinned: the learning cycle is longer than what has been observed
rules.hint.unused: a rare case, or not a rule at all?
rules.title: Rules, by hits
shape.stuck: hugging the floor = practising without learning
title: Self-evolving
